description: A battalion maintenance officer must publish a two-day preventive-maintenance outage calendar for the water treatment plant and communications annex, including backup support and the follow-on generator test needed to keep both facilities operational.

shared_context.S1: The water treatment plant and communications annex both require preventive maintenance during the next two workdays.
shared_context.S2: Only one battalion maintenance crew is available, so the two outages cannot overlap.
shared_context.S3: The maintenance officer publishes the final outage calendar and assigns any required support.
shared_context.S4: The water plant normally remains in service during work unless a temporary backup supply is arranged.
shared_context.S5: At the routine maintenance coordination huddle, Maj. Alvarez asks the facilities and signal leads to report current constraints before the calendar is published.
shared_context.S6: The huddle follows the standing practice of hearing a brief current-constraints report from each lead before the maintenance calendar is published.

PF1.text: SFC Morgan confirmed this morning that the water-treatment contractor is available only Tuesday from 0900 to 1100, and the plant must have a 600-gallon water-truck backup during that outage; the contractor confirmation is in the facilities email but has not yet been entered on the battalion maintenance calendar.

PF2.text: Lt. Okafor confirmed that the communications annex UPS test must run Wednesday from 1300 to 1500, followed immediately at 1500 by a 30-minute generator-transfer test with the signal shop present; the vendor appointment is on the signal section's working schedule but has not yet been added to the battalion calendar.

acceptance_conditions: The water treatment plant outage must be scheduled for Tuesday 0900-1100.
A 600-gallon water-truck backup must be assigned for the water plant outage.
The communications annex UPS test must be scheduled for Wednesday 1300-1500.
The generator-transfer test must be scheduled for 1500 immediately after the UPS test.
The calendar must include coordination for the water truck, UPS vendor, and generator-transfer test.
The communications scheduling requirement must be cited from the signal section's reported fact.

content_checks.C5: any(('600-gallon' in c['detail'] or '600 gallon' in c['detail'] or '600-Gallon' in c['detail'] or '600 Gallon' in c['detail']) and ('water' in c['detail'] or 'Water' in c['detail'] or 'truck' in c['detail'] or 'Truck' in c['detail'] or 'backup' in c['detail'] or 'Backup' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: decisions['generator_transfer_test_time'] in ['Wednesday 1500-1530', 'Wednesday 1500 to 1530', 'Wednesday 1500–1530'] or any(('signal' in c['detail'] or 'Signal' in c['detail']) and (('transfer' in c['detail'] or 'Transfer' in c['detail']) or ('generator' in c['detail'] or 'Generator' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any('vendor' in c['detail'] or 'Vendor' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) or any(('signal' in c['detail'] or 'Signal' in c['detail']) and (('generator-transfer' in c['detail'] or 'Generator-transfer' in c['detail']) or ('generator transfer' in c['detail'] or 'Generator transfer' in c['detail']) or ('transfer test' in c['detail'] or 'Transfer test' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The contractor's Tuesday 0900-1100 appointment fixes the water-plant outage window, while the stated 600-gallon backup requirement changes the backup quantity and creates the water-truck commitment.
The vendor appointment fixes the UPS test at Wednesday 1300-1500, and the required immediate 1500-1530 transfer test changes the follow-on time and requires UPS-vendor and signal-shop coordination.
